# Code Anchors: Ephemeral Hand-Off Entry

- `.gitignore` — the ignore rule that makes the hand-off area version-ignored, so nothing written there can be committed or carry a committed deletion.
- `.claude/commands/nxs.close.md` — Input Resolution option 4 and Phase 4: an issue-sourced local close resolves the epic into the ephemeral area and writes `close-record.md` there as hand-off content, never committed and never described as committed.
- `.claude/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — the contractual receipt placement: `analyze-receipt.md` beside the materialized epic in the ephemeral area for an issue-sourced epic, the committed entry for an old-contract one, no file at all in PR mode.
- `.claude/commands/nxs.distill.md` — discovery of ephemeral entries, the close-record-required drainability test, consumption derived from the trunk store's structured provenance, the two-test merge precondition (range-head reachability, else merged-PR resolution), the `range-unresolvable` hard error, exclusion from drain-SLO, and the removal re-aimed at the committed scratch dir.
- `.claude/skills/nxs-epic-resolve/scripts/epic_resolve.ts` — the resolver that materializes the epic into this area; its epic-only output is scratch, not a drainable entry.
